authority_boundary: Rankers may order existing sanitized candidate IDs only. They do not receive payloads, SQL source, expected results, BenchmarkTest IDs, execution tools or verifier authority.

fields.name: candidate_id
fields.purpose: Opaque stable identifier used for ordering only.

fields.name: sanitized_action_path
fields.purpose: Neutral path-like placeholder so structural path depth can be represented without exposing OWASP routes.

fields.name: http_method
fields.purpose: Transport-level method category available before testing.

fields.name: input_carrier
fields.purpose: Structural carrier type such as query parameter, form parameter, header or cookie.

fields.name: input_count_category
fields.purpose: Coarse parameter-count category used for prioritization without exposing original names.

fields.name: editable_input_count
fields.purpose: Count of controllable inputs visible to the deterministic adapter.

fields.name: multiple_parameters
fields.purpose: Boolean structural signal for multi-input requests.

fields.name: transport_adapter_category
fields.purpose: Coarse adapter class needed to construct the request deterministically.
